readerCopy.body: Being admired for one version of a role can put pressure on the parts that refuse to keep performing the same agreement. When the Sun opposes Lilith, recognition and autonomy face each other directly, making praise, status, visibility, or approval harder to enjoy when another person or group expects the rewarded version to remain unchanged. The conflict is not always between success and refusal. It can be about who gets to decide which parts of success are still worth keeping once the terms become visible.
